AND FORMER EMPLOYEES.

At 5.40p.m. 12-9-32 a telephone message was received
from 349 Ningpo Road to the effect that a number of coolies
were causing trouble there.

The undersigned, S/I Moffat, C.D.S.60 and a party
of Police attended but no signs of any trouble was notice-

on the pavement outside of Ningpo Road Electric Sub-Stat-

The persons 15 in number were taken to the Station
for interrogation.

From enquiries made by C.D.S.60 and the undersigned
it was ascertained that the informant in this case named

owner of the Dong Yuen Coal Hong, Pootung, and the Dah

Road. It was further ascertained that about June 1930
complainant opened a Coal-yard in Pootung for the making
of briquettes, and employed 26 coolies to work for him.

Coal-yard owing to lack of support and business. He fur-
ther stated that prior to closing he dismissed the men

1932年9月12日下午5时40分，接到来自宁波路349号的电话消息，称有一群苦力在那里滋事。

Subject (in full) Students collecting money

Sir:
At 1.50 p.m. 30-6-32, F.P.S: Berthel brought to the
Station two students of the Tsung Yah College and China

the 28-6-32 the above named person's collecting boxes were
sealed in their presence, and the men allowed to depart
after they had been given a stern verbal question WARNING.

brought to this Station up to 3.a.m.1-7 32. With the boxes

the students were members of an association opposing the
the cessation of Anti-Japanese Hostility.

截至1932年7月1日凌晨3时，仅有上述两个箱子被带至本捕房。随箱子一起查获了一面小旗，上面的文字表明这些学生是一个反对停止抗日敌对行动的协会的成员。

FIFTY WORKERS OF THE AN LOH COTTON WEAVING
COMPANY 455 NANKING ROAD, REFUSING TO LEAVE
THE PREMISES.

At 10.a.m. 23-6-32, the attached letter was
received at this Station regarding the above.

From enquiries made by C.D.S.80 and D.S.Logan,
it was learned that 50 employees of the above Company,
formerly employed at the Company's factory on Yochow
Road, whose contract with the Company expired in
December, 1931, walked into the Company's shop at
455 Nanking Road, and demanded compensation for the
period January to June, during which time they were
unemployed due to the factory having ceased to func-
tion. Compensation was refused and they thereupon
refused to leave the premises. It appears that the
above Company is in financial difficulty and in con-
sequence engaged Dr. John C.H. Wu as liquidator.
Mr. Ao Sen ( ) attorney at law, 72 Szechuen Road,
was engaged by the above Company to negotiate with
the workers, and on his instructions they were ordered
to leave 455 Nanking Road at 12.m.d. this date. By
12.30 p.m., they left the premises without incident
and proceeded to the factory on Yochow Road, Wayside
informed through C.O.R.

经刑事侦探股第80号警员（C.D.S.80）和警司洛根（D.S.Logan）查询得知，上述公司的前员工50人，此前受雇于该公司位于扬州路的工厂，其与公司的合同于1931年12月到期，他们走进位于南京路455号的公司店铺，要求赔偿一月至六月期间的损失，在此期间因工厂停止运作而失业。赔偿要求被拒绝，他们随即拒绝离开该场所。据悉，上述公司面临财务困难，因此聘请吴经熊博士（Dr. John C.H.
